_about: Settings for tools/mapgen.py (DXF -> per-board Pixelblaze maps). Counts, wiring and directions come from src/template/orcar_3d_mapped.js, NOT from here. See docs/MAP_GENERATION.md.
_names: DXF group name -> template feature name. Names not listed here are used as-is. The EVEN spines are labelled on the wrong side in the DXF (S2/S4 on port, S8/S10 on starboard), so they are swapped here. If the DXF labels are ever corrected, delete those eight swap entries -- the convention check will tell you if they're wrong.
_ignore: DXF groups that are not LED strands and play no part in the box. The unnamed group is reference geometry (it extends far below ground and past the truck).
_placeholder: Strands with pixels but no geometry get one entry per pixel at this point (inches): on the centreline, mid-body between R6 and R7, ~halfway up the arches. Needed because render3D() skips pixels past the end of a map.
_ghost_box: 'mapped' = bounding box of the strands that currently have counts (the box grows -- and every normalized coordinate shifts -- whenever a new strand is mapped). 'all' = bounding box of ALL strand geometry in the DXF, counted or not (stable until the DXF changes). Or give [[minx,miny,minz],[maxx,maxy,maxz]] explicitly. Set to 'all' on 2026-10-18 (whole sculpture, nose tip to fluke tips).
_box_extra: DXF groups that are not LED strands but must still lie inside the ghost box (with ghost_box 'all'), so the box won't have to grow if they get LEDs later.
_gap_tolerance: Inches. Breaks in a drawn path shorter than this are bridged (and reported). Larger breaks are an error.
_pitch: Expected LED spacing along a strand, inches. Used only to WARN when a count looks wrong for the strand's drawn length.
